name: AISearch
description: AI Search is a one-for-one port of the standard ZDS Search onto the AI surface. Both libraries describe the same two component sets — Search (Size x Condensed) and Dropdown Filter (Orientation x Size) — and both build them over a single shared field whose left icon and caret are independent toggles. That shared box is the whole reason the two sets cannot drift apart.
intent: The standard Search, themed. Teal becomes AI brand, square corners become rounded, and the field gains a focus ring.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: AISearch · condensed
props.hint: Icon-only round trigger, exactly height x height. Suppresses the button.

props.name: AISearch · button
props.hint: Render the solid brand submit button beside the field.

props.name: AISearch · value
props.hint: Controlled value. A non-empty value flips the text upright.

props.name: AISearch · onSearch
props.hint: Fires on submit, or on click in the condensed variant.

props.name: AISearch · busy
props.hint: AI-only. Indeterminate hairline under the field.

props.name: AISearch · disabled
props.hint: Dims to 0.55 and drops the ring.

props.name: AISearchField · leftIcon
props.hint: Show the magnifier. Off on the dropdown select field.

props.name: AISearchField · caret
props.hint: Show the caret. On for the dropdown select field.

props.name: AISearchField · asSelect
props.hint: Render a listbox trigger button instead of a text input.

props.name: AISearchField · focusState
props.hint: Force the focused visual for docs and previews.
